newsitem.title: USA: AMEX February short interest sets record.
newsitem.headline: AMEX February short interest sets record.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said short interest totalled a record 136,385,204 shares as of the February 14 settlement date, an increase of 14.2 million shares from the 122.1 million shares (adjusted) reported in mid-January.
The AMEX said the previous record was 127,956,065, set in June 1996.
The February short interest position reflects short interest reported by all broker-dealers in AMEX listed stocks.
